test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. Their names were Amulius and Numitor and both were equally brave.

B. The people of Alba could not decide who should be made the King.

C. It so happened that the King of Alba died leaving behind two sons.

D. In the beautiful land of Italy, there was a city called Alba.
solution:
The correct answer is 'DCAB.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 __
 
• The first statement in the sequence should be **D** as it introduces the subject 'Alba.'
 
• C follows D because it is talking about the King of Alba.
 
• A follows C because it is adding more information about the two sons.
 
• D provides a conclusion to the story.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is 'DCAB.'
 
• ​​The correct sequence__:​

D. In the beautiful land of Italy, there was a city called Alba.

C. It so happened that the King of Alba died leaving behind two sons.

A. Their names were Amulius and Numitor and both were equally brave.

B. The people of Alba could not decide who should be made the King.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 

 

 

 

__
 
• Steps for solving Para Jumbles:
 
 
• Clues include pronouns, like he, she, it, this, that, these, those; adverbs like formally, really; article a, an and the; definers like actually, finally, another; connectors like but, yet, both, also and neither nor, or, however, nevertheless.
 
• Now, with the help of clues, try to find out qualifier and qualified sentences, so that we can make pairs of qualified and qualifier sentences to eliminate the wrong choices given in the question.
 
• After making pairs, start eliminating the wrong choices or options given in the question.
 
• In case there is more than one choice, try to follow the sequence of sentences according to the occurrence of the events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

 
• विकल्पों में दिए गए गद्यांश के भागों को व्यवस्थित करते समय, हमें उनके बीच कुछ व्याकरणिक या प्रासंगिक संबंध खोजने होंगे, तो आइए जानें।
 
 
• **अनुक्रम में पहला कथन D होना चाहिए** क्योंकि यह विषय 'अल्बा' का परिचय देता है।
 
• **C, D का अनुसरण करता है** क्योंकि यह अल्बा के राजा के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
• **A, C का अनुसरण करता है** क्योंकि यह दो पुत्रों के बारे में अधिक जानकारी जोड़ रहा है।
 
• **D** कहानी को निष्कर्ष प्रदान करता है।
 
 
 
• इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर 'DCAB' है।
